instruction: Apply justification to paragraphs 5–9 in the document.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires justify-aligning paragraphs 5-9 (content paragraph indices 4-8, using 0-based indexing). WD_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT.JUSTIFY = 3. Verified by reading document structure. Evaluator checks alignment values for paragraphs 4, 5, 6, 7, 8.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Full credit (1.0) if all 5 paragraphs are justify-aligned, partial credit proportional to number of correctly aligned paragraphs
